Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl

Class CubemapTarget

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl.CubemapTarget
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CubemapTarget extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Native OpenGL cubemap texture owned by the spherical rendering pipeline.

This target owns the GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP allocation, a reusable face framebuffer, and a depth renderbuffer. The qualified runtime attaches one canonical face at a time and copies the resolved Processing scratch colour into it entirely on the GPU.

    • renderFace

      public void renderFace(CubemapFace face, processing.opengl.PGraphicsOpenGL graphics, Runnable renderOperation)
      Binds a cubemap face as the active draw framebuffer and runs the supplied GPU operation.

      One framebuffer is reused while framebufferTexture2D attaches each GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_* face. The qualified capture uses the callback to blit from the resolved Processing scratch framebuffer.

      Parameters:
      face - target cubemap face
      graphics - Processing OpenGL target providing the active context
      renderOperation - GPU operation executed while the face is attached

    • renderFace

      public void renderFace(CubemapFace face, processing.opengl.PGraphicsOpenGL graphics, Consumer<processing.opengl.PGL> renderOperation)
      Binds a cubemap face and exposes the already-active PGL context to the render pass.

      The overload is intended for native transfers or passes that must share the exact face framebuffer and Processing context. Callers must not invoke beginPGL() or endPGL() from inside the operation.

      Parameters:
      face - target cubemap face
      graphics - Processing OpenGL target providing the active context
      renderOperation - operation receiving the active PGL context
